sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Amazon search: the Butler chip row no longer overlaps the next product's title. It now sits inside each product card
Amazon search: units per month now respects Amazon's own bought in past month figure, and a rating or price right before it can no longer inflate the count
Amazon search: a Typical price strikethrough is no longer shown as a Deal, and the percent off only shows for real cuts of 10% or more
Amazon search: a Campaign chip that has no matching campaign rate is dropped instead of lingering
Walmart search: tiles on Walmart's new layout are now scored (47 of 70 on a laptop search, up from 4), and the grid is re-scored when Walmart redraws it
Walmart: the extension now loads from the Walmart home page, product pages refresh when you move between products, and the Watch star no longer appears on Walmart tiles
Creator Hub: the Manage videos list at amazon.com/creatorhub now gets Video Money and YouTube chips
The tile menu button is now a clear three-dot icon, and toasts replace each other instead of stacking on top of one another
Global reach: countries that have not been checked now say so instead of claiming the product was not found there
The toolbar icon opens Settings on pages that have no panel instead of doing nothing, and the creator name on product videos no longer runs into Earns commissions

sections.heading: Other notable changes
items: The Draft caption and Draft voiceover buttons now say right next to them when they need your own OpenAI key, with a Connect OpenAI link. You pay OpenAI directly (usually pennies), and a ChatGPT subscription does not work
OpenAI errors are now clear and actionable: an invalid or revoked key tells you to create a new one, and an out-of-credit account tells you to add billing at platform.openai.com
Settings now explain up front that the AI section is optional, billed by OpenAI directly, and links to a setup guide
When the Butler's Brief is not available right now, it says so plainly and explains that your own OpenAI key makes it work reliably. The technical reason code is tucked behind a Details toggle

sections.heading: New Features
items: On event days like Prime Big Deal Days and Walmart Deals, sending a deal can also drop it into your Prime Day Deals workspace. Pick Off, Ask each time, or Always in Settings > Deals
Walmart deals you send to Deals Butler now carry the strikethrough regular price, so the posted deal shows the was price and the percent off instead of just the sale price

sections.heading: Other notable changes
items: The Copy Walmart link button now says Creating link while it builds your tracked Mavely or Walmart Creator link, and the link is copied reliably even when the build takes a few seconds. If the copy is ever blocked, the link is shown so you can copy it by hand
Set up Walmart affiliate links now opens Settings right at the Walmart affiliate links section
When the desktop app is open but slow to answer, the extension now says the app is busy instead of saying it is not running, and gives a sent deal more time to finish

sections.heading: New Features
items: Send to Deals now carries the extra coupon and the regular price from deal cards, like "40% off Code: ABC123 + 10% Coupon" and "(Reg.24.99)", so the posted deal shows the right savings

sections.heading: New Features
items: The Deal Sites Harvester can now import straight from a Google Sheet. Paste the sheet's share link in with your other sources (it needs to be set to "Anyone with the link can view"), and Butler reads one deal per row, the same way it reads a scraped deals page
Four more sites are bundled into the harvester by default: Daily Deals with Jat, Elva's Daily Deals, Simply Picks, and Noel's Daily Deals, alongside Save With Cindy

sections.heading: Other notable changes
items: The "Send to Deals Butler" workspace picker and push button now live in the pinned quick-links bar at the top of the panel, next to Get link and Scrub link, instead of further down the page
Adding an item to a new product list, or to a list created inline from the picker, now shows that list right away as the next target. Before, it stayed invisible in the picker until the page reloaded

Raised how long the extension waits for a busy desktop app to answer before showing "app isn't responding." Real-world checks showed the app's main thread can stay blocked 3 seconds or more during a deal harvest or storefront scan, so the connection probe now allows up to 1.5 seconds (was 0.7s) and the initial "is the app there" check allows up to 4 seconds. A closed app is still detected right away

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed findings piling up as "waiting to sync" and never reaching your web dashboard. When the desktop app was open but busy, its live mirror kept asking to try again, and that was holding your whole findings queue back, even though the dashboard sync is not supposed to need the app at all. Now the dashboard sync runs on its own and the app mirror is best-effort, so your scans, deals, and other findings upload on schedule again. A finding the server permanently rejects is also dropped instead of blocking everything behind it

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The extension now waits longer for a busy desktop app before deciding it is not there. When your app is mid-task (harvesting deals, scanning a storefront) it can take a couple of seconds to answer, and the old half-second cutoff read that as "app isn't responding" even though it was running. A closed app is still detected instantly, so this only adds patience when the app really is open

Your "When a deal arrives" choice (Settings > Deals) now applies everywhere you send a deal, not just the per-product button on deal sites. Deals sent from the Deal Sites Harvester, the search-results overlay, and the Send to Deals Butler button on product pages all follow your placement now, whether that is save as a draft, next in the queue, a random spot, the end, or post right now. Before, those three paths ignored the setting and used the app's own default

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed the "Your Influencer Butler app isn't responding" notice showing even while the app was running and paired. The Send to your butler app section used to check for the app only once, at the instant the page loaded, and that first check could miss a perfectly healthy app. It now keeps checking every few seconds and swaps in your Deals Butler, Content Butler, and campaign buttons the moment the app answers, no reload needed

sections.heading: Other notable changes
items: Deals harvested from savewithcindy.shop now carry the full deal, not just the product. Butler reads each card's promo code, the code's own percent off, and the deal's start and end dates, and hands them to your desktop app. The code stacks on any Amazon coupon, the end date lets Expired Butler retire a deal once it is over, and the start date holds an upcoming deal until it opens

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Butler scores are back on the Sponsored Products for Creators tab. After Amazon rebuilt that tab, the match score and the EPC and Budget chips stopped appearing on its cards; they show again now, and keep showing as you switch between the Affiliate+ and Sponsored Products tabs or scroll for more

Today's Deals gets its Butler chips back. An Amazon redesign of the deals grid had left the badges off every deal card; each deal now shows its Butler Score, estimated commission, and campaign eligibility again, and newly loaded deals get scored as you scroll

Benable list pages score reliably again. The Amazon money chip was missing from most cards because it waited on each card's image to finish loading; it now reads each card directly, so every Amazon item on a list gets its commission and campaign signals right away

sections.heading: New Features
items: Campaign Radar now reads the Sponsored Products for Creators tab, not just Creator Connections. Every SPCC card gets a match score built from the signals SPCC actually gives you: an EPC up to $X chip from Amazon's own earnings-per-click forecast, a Budget: High, Medium or Low chip, and whether you already own the product or have earned on it. A Strong picks only switch keeps just the top band, so the best paying products rise to the top of the tab

On a product page, Butler now tells you when one of the videos on that listing is yours, and where it sits: "Your video: Upper carousel, #2 of 6", with a Yours badge on the card itself. It learns which videos are yours quietly as you visit your own Creator Hub, My content, and storefront pages, so nothing is guessed about videos it has no evidence for. Turn it off under Video competition if you would rather not see it

See at a glance whether each of your Amazon videos is already on YouTube. A chip now sits on your Creator Hub manage list, the video Edit post page, your storefront, and your My Content list: green On YouTube (links to the video) when your desktop app has cross-posted it, or Not on YouTube with an Upload to YouTube button that hands the video to your desktop app to upload. It also shows a Showing on Amazon or Not on detail pages chip read straight from the page. The YouTube status needs your desktop app running and paired; the Amazon chip works either way

Schedule a social post in two clicks: right-click any image on the web (a retailer grid, Instagram, Pinterest, a blog) and pick Schedule to Social Posting Butler, or use the Schedule action on Amazon and Walmart product and search tiles. Write a caption or draft one with AI, choose a one-time or repeating time on a mini calendar, and your desktop app posts it. No more saving the image, opening the app, and setting it all up by hand

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Amazon Creator API keys you save in Settings now reach your Influencer Butler account, not just the browser you typed them into. Before, keys could sit on one device while Amazon pages kept asking you to connect. Settings now says plainly whether the keys made it to your account, and gives you a Retry when they did not

Panels that ask the extension for data (your watchlist, product lists, and international availability) no longer sit on a loading message forever when the extension's background worker is asleep or the page was left open through an update. They now say Butler could not reach the extension and ask you to reload the page, so a stuck panel is never mistaken for an empty one
Send to your butler app now tells you to reopen the app when it is installed and paired but not answering, instead of showing the same install pitch a brand-new user sees
A product that only hints at a Creator Connections campaign now offers Check for CC campaign rather than Accept CC campaign, so the button no longer promises a campaign that has not been confirmed
International availability no longer asks you to connect the Amazon Creator API after a request simply failed; the connect prompt now appears only when the API really is unconnected

sections.heading: New Features
items: See at a glance whether each of your Amazon videos is already on YouTube. A chip now sits on your Creator Hub manage list, the video Edit post page, your storefront, and your My Content list: green On YouTube (links to the video) when your desktop app has cross-posted it, or Not on YouTube with an Upload to YouTube button that hands the video to your desktop app to upload. It also shows a Showing on Amazon or Not on detail pages chip read straight from the page. The YouTube status needs your desktop app running and paired; the Amazon chip works either way

Write a caption or draft one with AI, choose a one-time or repeating time on a mini calendar, and your desktop app posts it. No more saving the image, opening the app, and setting it all up by hand

sections.heading: New Features
items: Video Likes: an orange heart badge on Amazon video and content cards shows how many likes each video has, both on your storefront and on product pages. It is on by default, with an off switch under Video like counts in settings

The Product snapshot now shows how old a listing is and how many sellers share the buy box, so you can read a product's freshness and how crowded it is at a glance (the seller chip turns amber once five or more sellers are on the listing)

Conversion rate (orders per click) now appears where it helps: your product's earnings panel headlines its best-converting campaign, the full breakdown tags the best converter, and campaign cards and The Butler's Brief show a campaign's conversion whenever Amazon exposes it
The price history panel adds a 12-month sales histogram with the peak month called out, plus a 90-day rank trend with a one-word read of rising, steady, or slipping
Search-results tiles that are in a clicks-based Amazon campaign but have no fixed commission now show Amazon's own per-click forecast (Campaign: up to $X/click) instead of a bare Campaign label

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Tile badges on Amazon Idea List pages no longer hide behind the next row of tiles, so every badge stays visible

sections.heading: New Features
items: Accept Creator Connections campaigns right from the extension, without opening the desktop app, with an optional rule-based auto-accept that keeps a 30-day history so the same campaign is never taken twice
A floating chat bubble on the pages the extension runs on: chat with the AI concierge, or file a bug, feature request, or question with screenshots, and review your past reports
Highest-commission routing is now on out of the box for new installs, so each product's link automatically picks the provider that pays the most (if you turned it off, it stays off)

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Butler's Brief campaign verdict now waits for the campaign's product list to finish loading before deciding, so it no longer flashes a No products detected card on slower pages
Tile badges on Amazon search results no longer paint over the product title

The Product data card no longer shows a red credential error while Influencer Butler's backup credentials are covering product data, and the per-field STORED badges now appear only on the fields you actually saved

sections.heading: New Features
items: The Amazon Creators API card now takes the official Creator API credentials (Credential ID, Secret, and Version) instead of the older Product Advertising API keys, and warns you if you paste the wrong kind of key

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Typical length stat on product pages now comes from the real runtimes of the videos in the carousel, and stays hidden when there are too few to be trustworthy
The Creators API setup video on the settings page plays again instead of showing an error

sections.heading: Other Notable Changes
items: Creator Connections and SPCC status now lives at the bottom of the Product snapshot card, and each program always shows enrolled, available, or not available once its list is downloaded

sections.heading: New Features
items: A guided setup walkthrough opens on first install and can be replayed any time from the Setup guide link in the popup
Your storefront handle is filled in automatically the first time you visit your Creator Hub, so you never have to type it
Settings sync with the desktop app: pairing fills in empty fields on both sides, and a Sync now button reconciles the rest
The popup can be resized by dragging its corner, and it remembers the size you choose
The Creators API setup video now plays right on the settings card where you paste your keys

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Send to app panel now tells you the desktop app is not paired yet instead of showing buttons that do nothing

sections.heading: Other Notable Changes
items: The popup side menu scrolls on its own and uses shorter labels so every item fits on one line

sections.heading: New Features
items: Product pages show an Enrolled badge when you are already accepted into a Creator Connections or SPCC campaign for that item, along with your accepted rate and earnings per click
A welcome page opens right after a fresh install to help you get set up
A friendly community reminder a few days after install explains that the Facebook group is for tips and wins, with a Report a bug button that takes issues straight to Feedback Butler

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Sending feedback from the extension is more reliable

sections.heading: New Features
items: Money signals now appear on the Amazon Today's Deals grid, including Coupons, Lightning Deals, and Outlet, with the same Butler Score, verdict, commission, and sorting tools as search results
When The Butler's Brief cannot be written, Campaign Butler now explains that connecting an OpenAI key gets you a full brief and offers a shortcut to settings

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Butler's Brief now recovers when the first AI provider fails, and shows a short reason when a brief still cannot be written
Video Money badges are back on the redesigned Creator Hub Manage videos page, and the page no longer freezes while your storefront loads
The popup no longer crashes when your product lists cannot be loaded

sections.heading: New Features
items: What's New: after the extension updates, you now get a quick note of what changed, right on the page and in the popup, including any issues you reported that we fixed
Campaign Butler: a per-campaign verdict panel that tells you at a glance whether a Creator Connections campaign is worth your time
Last Call Butler: a fill meter and a watch bell so you can jump on campaigns before they fill up

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Connect buttons in the popup stay in view, and the two-step sync is easier to follow
Amazon Creators API (PA-API) Test Connection now explains exactly what went wrong instead of failing silently
The extension now activates on tabs you already had open when it installs or updates, so you do not have to reload

sections.heading: Other Notable Changes
items: Link Butler now shows the product and campaign behind each branded link
Book a call shows a friendly timezone name next to the technical id
